advisory.summary: Do not compile secrets into binaries. advisory.impact: [severity: high] Credential theft leading to unauthorised access to the systems or services that accept this secret, and no easy rotation path. The exposed password grants direct login until rotated.
advisory.remediation_patch:
```python
# BEFORE: PASSWORD = "Sup3rS3cret!"   # baked into the file

if not PASSWORD:
    raise RuntimeError('APP_PASSWORD not set; refusing to start')

# Preferred: short-lived lease from a vault
# secret = vault_client.read_latest('kv/credentials/app')
```

advisory.summary: Compile with '-fPIE' and link with '-pie'.

advisory.remediation_patch:

CFLAGS += -fPIE

advisory.title: Writable Global Offset Table (Missing Full RELRO)
advisory.summary: Link the binary with '-Wl,-z,relro,-z,now' to enforce immediate binding and read-only GOT pages.
advisory.plain_english: The binary lacks Full RELRO (Read-Only Relocations). The Global Offset Table (GOT) remains writable at runtime, allowing attackers to overwrite dynamic function pointers. This finding was CONFIRMED by the Verification Service.
advisory.impact: [severity: medium] Attackers can hijack library calls (such as exit, printf, or puts) to redirect execution flow.
advisory.remediation_patch:

LDFLAGS += -Wl,-z,relro,-z,now
```
advisory.cwe_id: CWE-732 (Incorrect Permission Assignment for Critical Resource)
advisory.threat_vector: Global Offset Table (GOT) Overwrite / PLT Hijacking

```
